items.title: Southeastern Oklahoma State University hit by InterLock ransomware
items.summary: The public university in Durant, Oklahoma disclosed a significant data breach after an attack claimed by the InterLock ransomware group in mid-August, with fallout still being assessed this cycle.

items.title: Babcock Africa claimed by TheGentlemen ransomware group
items.summary: The engineering and asset management firm was named as a victim by the TheGentlemen ransomware group in recent leak-site postings.

items.title: Roadvision Systems (New Hampshire) claimed by TheGentlemen ransomware group
items.summary: The Hanover, NH-based company was listed as a victim on the TheGentlemen ransomware group's leak site.

items.title: Peru's National Water Authority claimed by Black Shrantac group
items.summary: A government water infrastructure agency in Peru was named as a ransomware victim by the Black Shrantac group, raising availability concerns for public water services.

ransomware.note: Fresh named-victim disclosures were thin this cycle; most confirmed leak-site postings trace back to the first half of September or late August.

items.title: Azure East US outage disrupts ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok
items.summary: An Azure East US region outage on September 3 caused roughly 90 minutes of downtime that cascaded into major AI services including ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok, hitting UK business hours particularly hard.

outage.note: Only one distinct September-dated hyperscaler incident surfaced; broader 2026 outage trend coverage (AWS/GCP) referenced May and July events outside this window and was excluded.

items.title: CISA adds critical Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center auth bypass to KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-20079 (CVSS 10.0), an unauthenticated remote root-access flaw in Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center, was added to CISA's KEV catalog with a September 12 federal patch deadline.

items.title: CISA adds Citrix NetScaler auth bypass to KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-19490 (CVSS 9.3), an authentication bypass in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway, joined the same September KEV batch alongside the Cisco and Fortinet flaws.

items.title: PivotC2 RAT campaign tied to Russian-speaking threat actor
items.summary: A financially motivated campaign has weaponized a vulnerability to deploy the PivotC2 Node.js remote access trojan, targeting more than 3,000 IP addresses and infecting 178 devices to date.

items.title: Hurricane Lowell threatens Hawaii
items.summary: Hurricane Lowell prompted school and government office closures on Kauai and Niihau, with forecasters warning of damaging winds, possible tornadoes, and dangerous rip currents.

items.title: Elevated wildfire danger forecast across Canada
items.summary: Canadian officials warned that wildland fire danger will run higher than normal through September across most provinces, excluding Alberta and Saskatchewan, following a destructive summer fire season.

items.title: Monsoon flooding persists in the Philippines
items.summary: Ongoing monsoon rains have kept large areas of the Philippines under flood conditions, with local officials expecting the situation to continue through the week.

items.title: M 6.5 earthquake strikes near Teluknaga, Indonesia
items.summary: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck 126 km NNE of Teluknaga, Indonesia on September 11 with no tsunami warning issued.

physical.note: A widely-cached reference to "Typhoon Saudel" hitting China was excluded as an apparent stale/mis-dated search result (matches an October 2020 storm of that name, not a September 2026 event).
